(I)--A daughter of सयाति: when once she went with her father to the hermitage of Cyavana, she saw an anthill with two luminous objects in holes which she pricked with a thorn. This resulted in blood-flowing from the eyes of the sage Cyavana. The king asked the sage's pardon by giving his daughter in marriage. अश्विन्स् called on them and made Cyavana look young to the puzzle of सुकन्या. The अश्विन्स् revealed to her of Cyavana's rejuvena- tion. Once her father came and seeing her with a young man, he took him to be her paramour and scolded her. But when he heard the truth of the matter he was pleased. भा.
